CALLOUT.CALLOUTADVISORY: A body has been found next to a farmhouse in North Yankton.
CALLOUT.TASK: Drive to the ~b~scene. The officer~s~ is waiting there for you.

COP1.DIALOGUE: ~b~Cop:~s~ Welcome to the cold and snowy North Yankton!
~b~Cop:~s~ Unfortunately, we've found a dead body over there. We don't know much yet, so you should search the scene first.
~b~Cop:~s~ After that, we have three possible suspects. You'll have to drive down the road to speak with them.
~b~Cop:~s~ There's also a neighbour who told us he witnessed something...

COP1_MURDERERCHOSEN.DIALOGUE: ~b~Cop:~s~ Tell me, who do you think the murderer is?

SUSPECT1_INNOCENT.DIALOGUE: ~y~You:~s~ Hello, sir. I have a few questions for you. You're a possible suspect in a recent homicide. What's your name?
~y~Suspect:~s~ A homicide? That's horrible! My name is James Walker, but you can call me Jimmy.
~y~Suspect:~s~ No, and I'm proud of it.
~y~You:~s~ What do you do for a living?
~y~Suspect:~s~ I'm a mechanic. I work on cars.
~y~Suspect:~s~ Not really. Sometimes I have a beer.
~y~Suspect:~s~ Yes, I own quite a few watches. I need them for work.
~y~You:~s~ Where were you when the victim died?
~y~Suspect:~s~ I was talking to a customer about his broken car. I told him it couldn't be repaired.

SUSPECT1_GUILTY.DIALOGUE: ~y~You:~s~ Hello, sir. You're suspected of having murdered someone. I have a few questions for you. Let's start with your name.
~y~Suspect:~s~ I didn't do anything! My name is James Walker, but my friends call me Jimmy.
~y~Suspect:~s~ No, and I'm proud of it.
~y~You:~s~ What do you do for a living?
~y~Suspect:~s~ I'm a mechanic. I work on cars.
~y~Suspect:~s~ Not really. Sometimes I have a beer.
~y~Suspect:~s~ Yes, I am... Oh, I've lost it.
~y~You:~s~ Where were you when the victim died?
~y~Suspect:~s~ I... was in my garage fixing cars. I was the last one there.
~y~Suspect:~s~ Yes, I have a lot of work to do.

SUSPECT2_INNOCENT.DIALOGUE: ~y~You:~s~ Hello, ma'am. You're suspected of having murdered someone. I have a few questions for you. Let's start with your name.
~y~Suspect:~s~ Damn, a homicide? Me? I haven't done anything. My name is Lisa Carter.
~y~Suspect:~s~ Yes, sometimes. Have you ever smoked weed?
~y~You:~s~ ...What do you do for a living?
~y~Suspect:~s~ I work in an office in town.
~y~Suspect:~s~ Yeah, unfortunately, quite a lot. Sometimes whiskey, sometimes champagne.
~y~Suspect:~s~ I don't like guns, so no.
~y~Suspect:~s~ I have one, but I never wear it. Why do you ask?
~y~You:~s~ Where were you when the victim died?
~y~Suspect:~s~ I was out with a friend of mine. You can ask her.

SUSPECT2_GUILTY.DIALOGUE: ~y~You:~s~ Hello, ma'am. You're suspected of having murdered someone. I have a few questions for you. Let's start with your name.
~y~Suspect:~s~ Damn, a homicide? Me? I haven't done anything. My name is Lisa Carter.
~y~Suspect:~s~ Yes, I smoke occasionally. Do you smoke weed?
~y~You:~s~ ...What do you do for a living?
~y~Suspect:~s~ I work in an office in town.
~y~Suspect:~s~ Yeah, unfortunately, quite a lot. Sometimes whiskey, sometimes champagne.
~y~Suspect:~s~ I don't like guns, so no.
~y~You:~s~ What kind of watch do you own?
~y~Suspect:~s~ I have one, but I never wear it. Why do you ask?
~y~You:~s~ Where were you when the victim died?
~y~Suspect:~s~ I was out partying at a club. I drank a lot of wine.

SUSPECT3_INNOCENT.DIALOGUE: ~y~You:~s~ Hello, sir. I have a few questions for you. You're a possible suspect in a recent homicide. What's your name?
~y~Suspect:~s~ Damn, a homicide? Me? I haven't done anything. My name is Daniel, but you can call me Danny Reed.
~y~Suspect:~s~ You know I'm a hunter and have plenty of time on my hands, so yes, I do smoke.
~y~You:~s~ What do you do for a living?
~y~Suspect:~s~ As I said, I'm a hunter.
~y~Suspect:~s~ No, not regularly. But I mean, I've had alcohol before.
~y~Suspect:~s~ Not right now, but as a hunter, you can imagine I own a few.
~y~You:~s~ What kind of watch do you own?
~y~Suspect:~s~ I have one. It's a cheap model, so if it breaks, I can just buy another one.
~y~You:~s~ Where were you when the victim died?
~y~Suspect:~s~ I was at home with my wife. We were having dinner.

SUSPECT3_GUILTY.DIALOGUE: ~y~You:~s~ Hello, sir. I have a few questions for you. You're a possible suspect in a recent homicide. What's your name?
~y~Suspect:~s~ Damn, a homicide? Me? I haven't done anything. My name is Daniel, but you can call me Danny Reed.
~y~Suspect:~s~ You know I'm a hunter and have plenty of time on my hands, so yes, I do smoke.
~y~You:~s~ What do you do for a living?
~y~Suspect:~s~ As I said, I'm a hunter.
~y~Suspect:~s~ No, not regularly. But I mean, I've had alcohol before.
~y~Suspect:~s~ Yes... I think I left it in my car. I can't find it.
~y~You:~s~ What kind of watch do you own?
~y~Suspect:~s~ I usually carry one, but I can't find it. Luckily, it wasn't expensive.
~y~You:~s~ Where were you when the victim died?
~y~Suspect:~s~ I was out hunting in the forest. Unfortunately, I didn't catch anything.

WITNESS_SUSPECT1.DIALOGUE: ~y~You:~s~ Hello, sir. My partner told me you witnessed something?
~g~Neighbour:~s~ Hi there! That's right. I'd like to report what I saw.
~g~Neighbour:~s~ I heard there had been a murder around the time I drove past.
~g~Neighbour:~s~ I saw a car driving away from the scene. There wasn't much traffic at the time.
~g~Neighbour:~s~ It looked like a company vehicle. It was a large van.

WITNESS_SUSPECT2.DIALOGUE: ~y~You:~s~ Hello, sir. My partner told me you witnessed something?
~g~Neighbour:~s~ Hi there! That's right. I'd like to report what I saw.
~g~Neighbour:~s~ I heard that a dead person had been found outside of town.
~g~Neighbour:~s~ I saw someone walking away from this area, holding something in their hand.
~g~Neighbour:~s~ It was smoking. I assume it was a cigar.

WITNESS_SUSPECT3.DIALOGUE: ~y~You:~s~ Hello, sir. My partner told me you witnessed something?
~g~Neighbour:~s~ Good evening. I think I may have witnessed something.
~g~Neighbour:~s~ I heard there had been a murder around the time I drove past the area.
~g~Neighbour:~s~ I saw a car driving away from the scene. There wasn't much traffic at the time.
~g~Neighbour:~s~ The car was very dirty and had large tires.
~g~Neighbour:~s~ I hope I was able to help!
